email.footer: Kvittel · physical delivery of kvittlach to the resting places of tzaddikim. Your kvittel’s content is never included in emails.

magic.subject: Your sign-in link
magic.title: Sign in to Kvittel
magic.body: Use the button below to sign in. The link is valid for 15 minutes.
magic.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

order.subject: Order {ref} confirmed
order.title: Your kvittel is on its way
order.body: Thank you. Payment was confirmed and your kvittel has joined the queue. You can follow each step through the private link below.
order.scheduled: Some deliveries are scheduled for the tziyun’s next service window (after Shabbat, Yom Tov or maintenance).
order.privacy: Keep this link private: it gives access to the status of your order.

delivered.subject: Delivered · {ref}
delivered.title: Your kvittel was delivered
delivered.body: Your kvittel was printed and passed into the opening at {grave}.

uncertain.subject: We are checking a delivery · {ref}
uncertain.title: We are checking this delivery
uncertain.body: The unit at {grave} could not confirm every step. Nothing will be printed twice automatically; our team is reviewing it.

failed.subject: Delivery not completed · {ref}
failed.title: Delivery not completed
failed.body: We could not deliver your kvittel at {grave}. You can choose a later delivery or a full refund.
